Release-grade source, license and third-party notice package

gates.reason: GPL-3.0 integration candidate is selected. Any distribution requires corresponding source, modifications and third-party notices; the receiver's cryptographic provenance still needs release-grade review.
iPhone 14 Pro and Xiaomi TV Box 4K acceptance is intentionally deferred. Emulator cannot prove real Wi-Fi discovery, video, audio or sync.

The full native receiver was clean-built from source, installed and ran on Android TV emulator x86_64. D-pad stop/restart, AirPlay/RAOP mDNS and foreground service state were observed. ARM64 and ARM32 APK libraries passed 16 KB zip alignment verification after the secure PIN-default update. The final release toolchain gate remains blocked until signed release artifacts and physical acceptance evidence exist.
jqssun/android-airplay-server is selected as the free GPL-3.0 integration candidate. Release selection remains conditional on license and physical acceptance gates.
